notes.title: Experience a New Phantom Journey in Persona5: The Phantom X
notes.content:
[h3]Dive deeper into the shadows of the Metaverse and unmask the story of P5X! The latest anime style JRPG in the Persona franchise by ATLUS is launching on Steam in June 26, 2025![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44538637/3cd2d5a4bc51814ee2ca24bc78812a327e1b287e.png[/img]

[h3]Watch the special trailer video here, featuring all-new stories and in-game footages.[/h3]
[previewyoutube=kyUw2oNGqBQ;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Wishlist here:[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3061570/Persona5_The_Phantom_X

[h3]To celebrate reaching 200,000 pre-registrations, we are giving away special gift 'Athleisure Outfit'![/h3]
Next, let's aim for the special gifts for 300,000 pre-registrations: the 'Avatar Frame' and 'Profile Card'!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44538637/8dd16208ee1d732a83a83734e93a6ce40abed071.png[/img]

[h3]Anime Expo 2025 Exhibition Confirmed![/h3]
P5X will appear at the SEGA ATLUS booth at Anime Expo 2025 from July 3rd to 5th, featuring numerous guests and giveaways.
Plus, you can enjoy a special live performance by Lyn Inaizumi during our panel event!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44538637/7d245a74199d176d93cf04963ff7a09c70bcd2a8.png[/img]

[h3]For more information on Persona5: The Phantom X, check our website and social media.[/h3]
Official Website - https://persona5x.com

Official Facebook Account - https://www.facebook.com/P5XOfficialWest

notes.title: Celebrating the One-Year Anniversary of Persona 3 Reload!
notes.content:
Crazy how time flies: It's already been one year since the release of Persona 3 Reload! We've been touched by the love the community has shown for this title, both from S.E.E.S. veterans and those that joined the squad for the first time this past year. Check out how we're celebrating the anniversary: 

[h2]Watch the Anniversary Special[/h2] 
We brought the incredible English voice cast (and Koromaru) together for a great time in our Persona 3 Reload Anniversary Special. Tune in as they fight shadows, answer your questions, and more!
[previewyoutube=DKziqp8RCA0;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Win Signed Items [/h2]
This is your opportunity at some very special Persona 3 Reload items: Enter our Anniversary Sweepstakes for a chance to own a copy of the game and poster signed by all the members of the main voice cast! Sweepstakes sign-up ends February 26. https://gleam.io/TkZZp/persona-3-reload-anniversary-sweepstakes [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44538637/6673f19536183b8cd78312c6d3f2c3709527b937.jpg[/img]
[h2]HYTE Y70 PC Case Now Available [/h2]
As revealed in the Anniversary Special, the new Persona 3 Reload HYTE Y70 PC case is now available! Enter the Dark Hour with this limited edition designed case featuring members of S.E.E.S. and Strega. Also pick up new Desk Pads featuring the Protagonist and Aigis. atlus.link/HYTE-P3R
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44538637/8d915cd8ef20c9f9b9fb8e121af9174d8faf94e7.jpg[/img]
[h2]Anniversary Illustration[/h2] 
Leaving you with a big thank you from Protag, Aigis, and Koro-chan: Check out this special illustration by Character Designer Azusa Shimada! 
[previewyoutube=WhEkLnle5Bw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Metaphor: ReFantazio Out Now!
notes.content:
The creative minds behind Persona 3, Persona 4, and Persona 5 proudly present ATLUS' latest fantasy RPG: [b]Metaphor: ReFantazio[/b]!

Join the Protagonist on a journey alongside his fairy companion, Gallica, to lift the curse from the kingdom’s lost prince. Control your destiny, face your fears, and awaken magical "Archetype" powers that lie dormant in your heart.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2679460/Metaphor_ReFantazio/

[previewyoutube=HnRzo99OqxU;full][/previewyoutube]--
[h2]Try the Prologue Demo![/h2]
Download and play the free Prologue Demo! The demo allows you to experience the beginning of the game, including exploring the first four dungeons, the ability to unlock seven Archetypes classes, and the opportunity to meet six followers. Best yet, your demo save data carries over to the full version.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3130330/Metaphor_ReFantazio__Prologue_Demo/

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.06/1.07
notes.content:
The latest patch has been released for Persona 3 Reload, which was released on 2/2/2024, and Persona 3 Reload: Expansion Pass, downloadable content that was released on 3/12/2024. Please see below for details:

[b]Persona 3 Reload[/b]
[list]
[*] The “Change Battle BGM” function has been expanded to allow different BGMs to be set for “Change Normal Battle BGM” and “Change Boss Battle BGM”.
[*] By registering any BGMs to “Favorite BGM” and then selecting “Favorite”, the registered music will be played randomly.
[*] The default song is now also subject to random playback.
[/list]
[b]Persona 3 Reload: Expansion Pass[/b]
[list]
[*] Added “Episode Aigis”, which depicts the story after the main story is completed. Persona 3 Reload: Expansion Pass is required to play.
[/list]
※The update patch will be applied automatically when the game is launched.

Thank you for your continued support of Persona 3 Reload!

notes.title: Play Episode Aigis -The Answer- Now!
notes.content:
Calling all S.E.E.S. members, Episode Aigis -The Answer- is finally here!

---
[h2]Go Beyond the Journey and Play Today [/h2]
After unravelling the mysteries of the Dark Hour, fighting epic battles through Tartarus, and all the unforgettable events of Persona 3 Reload, the S.E.E.S. members find themselves trapped in a never-ending March 31st. Journey through the Abyss of Time as Aigis, undertake new challenges, and uncover the cause of this strange fate and the truth of what happened on that day...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2689210/Persona_3_Reload_Expansion_Pass/
